verifier.method: Fresh route-scoped read at the required base. Both current PDFs and all current source, legal, route, packet-specification, approval, audit, acceptance and raster records were rehashed. Page counts were parsed with pdfinfo. All ten current PDF pages were rendered at 144 dpi and visually inspected, including direct crops of long boundary writes. PDF text geometry was independently measured with pdftotext bbox output. Actual writes, required-before-filing disclosures, protected blanks, route options, component routing, filing, fee, notice and self-help statements were reread. Focused packet completeness, packet-specification lookup, route resolver and generated-registry currency checks were run. No prior independent verdict was inherited.

verdictBasis: All fifteen exact-route packet obligations pass on the current bytes. The route remains product-path pending because its generated runtime/product graph was not regenerated after the exact packet specification was registered: the checked-in factory-v2 registry fails its own --check and exports an obsolete required-input contract for this route, while the paid-pathway legal join still records no family bridge or owner adoption. This is one derived-wiring defect, not a packet-byte or legal-input defect.

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: The exact obligation route, runtime identity, track, packet set and family agree across the source receipt, production field map, packet specification, route census, route acceptance, raster queue and current resolver. Every componentRoutes value is the exact obligation route; no neighbouring Virginia route is borrowed.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: This is CUSTOM_PLEADING_FROM_CODIFIED_TEXT and claims no source binary. The receipt's two named codified grounds exist and were rehashed from current committed bytes. Their exact VA track and packet-set objects remain the same substantive objects covered by the post-approval audit. Current route and legal registries were also rehashed; no source was missing or substituted.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: Both artifacts carry exactly primary_filing, records_checklist and filing_instructions. The exact route owns all three components, the packet specification binds the same three required documents in the same order, and no foreign-route component is present.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Seven of seven declared writes were read back from each artifact. Canonical name, birth date, address, telephone and email are visible on the primary filing and the name repeats on the checklist and instructions; the boundary persona's long name, address, telephone extension and email remain fully visible and readable in direct raster crops. knownRequiredFieldsMissing=0 and invisibleWrites=0.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: All eight declared participant-supplied items are printed and disclosed before filing: conviction locality, name at arrest, charge and Code section, conviction case number, arrest date and agency, offense date, disposition and date, and pardon date. The packet separately requires the certified absolute pardon and tells the participant to confirm its innocence language. requiredFactsNotCollected=0 and unclassifiedBlanks=0.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: There is one route and no participant election within it. The packet consistently selects only the subsection (I) absolute-pardon transmittal route, refuses to use CC-1473 or import the subsection (D) petition process, and makes the absolute-pardon-plus-innocence gate prominent. requiredOptionsMissing=0.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: The route contains no repeating table or row group, and no partly written row was found. incompleteRows=0.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: Participant signature and signature date remain blank in both artifacts. No court-, clerk-, prosecutor- or service-event field carries participant/platform ink; the actual-writes report contains only the seven permitted identity/contact writes. protectedWrites=0.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Current canonical and boundary bytes independently rehash to the supplied SHA-256 values, byte lengths and five-page counts. Those values match rendered-artifacts.json, the packet specification, owner adoption, post-approval audit, route acceptance and raster queue. The same PDF hashes exist at the original build commit, the raster-rendered commit, the queue packet commit and this base.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: Each five-page PDF follows its contiguous pageManifest: primary_filing pages 1-2, records_checklist page 3 and filing_instructions pages 4-5. Visual headings and extracted text confirm every component boundary.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: All ten current pages were freshly rendered at 144 dpi and visually inspected. No clipping, overlap, blank page, placeholder, protected ink or unintended mark was found; long boundary writes wrap cleanly. Independent bbox measurement found 0 of 1,569 canonical words and 0 of 1,572 boundary words outside page bounds, with zero same-line word overlaps. visualDefects=0.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: The packet directs the certified pardon and transmittal to the clerk of the circuit court of the locality of conviction. It correctly explains that a general-district record is handled through that locality's circuit-court clerk and does not tell the participant to file a subsection (A) petition.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The packet says subsection (I) states no filing fee for this transmittal and therefore includes no fee-waiver document. It separately identifies a possible CCRE record-copy charge as unknown and tells the participant to confirm that records cost without representing it as a court filing fee.

SERVICE.finding: The packet states that subsection (I) prescribes no service on another party and includes no certificate of service. It expressly refuses to import the Commonwealth's twenty-one-day subsection (D) petition window, while distinguishing the court's post-order copy to State Police under subsection (K).

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: The packet stops self-help if the pardon is not absolute or lacks innocence language, if the circuit court declines to enter the order after receipt, if the participant is still seeking the pardon itself, or if an immigration question exists. It names clerk, Secretary of the Commonwealth and lawyer/legal-aid handoffs without promising eligibility or relief.

nineCounters.routeCompletenessCheck: The current exact-route filter refuses before emitting rows because its single-route alias helper requires MASTER_QUEUE state COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN while this base records VERIFY_PENDING. The already committed route-completeness rows for these exact bytes report ROUTE_PASS_COMPLETE and all nine zero, but they were not substituted for the independent measurements above.

rasterEvidenceReviewed.problemCountBasis: scripts/rcap-raster-batch.mjs can emit RASTER_PASS only when its receipt problems array has length zero; any nonzero receipt problem emits RASTER_FAIL.
rasterEvidenceReviewed.routeAcceptanceProjectionArtifact: ROUTE_ARTIFACT_ACCEPTANCE.json projects the synthetic text 'the source receipt reports undefined problem(s)'. That text is not a workflow-receipt problem and was not accepted as visual evidence; it is another stale derived-record symptom. The queue's RASTER_PASS semantics and the fresh current-byte inspection supply the zero-problem evidence.
rasterEvidenceReviewed.basis: The RASTER_PASS semantics require every page rendered and zero clipping, overlap, placeholders or protected ink; the queue entry binds both exact hashes and both parsed page counts, the packet commit is an ancestor of this base, and the single assembled packet is the whole one-route family. The central artifact ZIP was not downloaded here. Acceptance is independently corroborated by fresh local rendering and inspection of all ten current canonical/boundary pages; workflow success alone was not treated as proof.

ownerApprovalAndAudit.postAuditChangeClassification: Later componentRoutes and packet-specification registration are route-to-family/product bookkeeping. The current PDFs retain the exact owner-pinned hashes and pages, and no later substantive packet or legal-design change was found.
ownerApprovalAndAudit.approvalScope: limited family-level legal-design approval only; no runtime, technical, visual, payment, sponsorship or production authority

productPathReview.exactRouteDeliveryDefect: The route's derived runtime/product graph is stale and internally inconsistent after packet-specification registration. data/record-clearing/factory-v2-route-registry.json fails node scripts/generate-rcap-factory-v2-registry.mjs --check. Its admitted VA route exports 15 requiredInputIds, while the current packetPlanForPathway for the same route exports those 15 plus date_of_birth, mailing_address, phone_number and email_address. The same stale graph leaves data/rcap-ledger/paid-pathway-legal-join.json saying packetFamilies=[], familyBridgePresent=false and no adoption record for this route even though the exact family and owner record now exist; its route-acceptance projection also emits an undefined source-problem placeholder that is absent from the zero-problem RASTER_PASS receipt semantics.
productPathReview.smallestExactRepair: Regenerate the authoritative derived route/product graph from the current packet specification and current owner/family bridge, confirm this exact route's registry input contract matches packetPlanForPathway, then rerun the factory-v2 registry check, focused resolver/wiring checks and exact-route completeness. Do not change the packet PDFs, field map, legal approval, raster receipt or route authority.
